system.name: ZRAID
system.one_liner: a software ZNS RAID layer that uses the Zone Random Write Area (ZRWA) to eliminate the partial-parity tax of ZNS RAID

components.name: Single ZNS Device
components.role: single logical ZNS device abstraction exposed to the application

components.name: Device Mapper
components.role: maps the logical ZNS device onto the ZRAID driver

components.name: ZRAID Driver
components.role: kernel-space driver implementing ZRAID's partial-parity and ZRWA management

components.name: Stripe Buffer
components.role: in-memory cache of data chunks in an incomplete stripe, used to generate partial and full parity chunks

components.name: WP States
components.role: in-memory write-pointer states read by the Completion Handler and updated after each WP advancement

components.name: ZRWA Block Bitmap
components.role: one bit per logical block in the ZRWA, tracking completion progress within the data area

components.name: I/O Submitter
components.role: generates sub-I/Os from host requests and submits them simultaneously to the I/O devices, gated by WP states

components.name: Completion Handler
components.role: aggregates sub-I/O completions, returns completion to the host, and updates the ZRWA block bitmap

components.name: ZRWA Manager
components.role: tracks ZRWA completion via the block bitmap and issues WP advancement via an explicit ZRWA flush command

components.name: I/O devices
components.role: underlying ZNS SSDs that receive sub-I/Os and WP-advance commands and raise completion interrupts

components.name: Dev 0
components.role: one physical ZNS device zone, showing its ZRWA/Durable/Semi-durable/PP/Empty regions by ascending PBA

components.name: Dev 1
components.role: a second physical ZNS device with the same zone layout as Dev 0

components.name: Dev 2
components.role: a third physical ZNS device with the same zone layout as Dev 0

flows.what: cached data chunks of an incomplete stripe (read/write)
WP advance via ZRWA flush command

content.key_idea: ZRAID's kernel driver temporarily stores partial parity inside each data zone's Zone Random Write Area, distributing parity writes across zones instead of dedicated log zones.
content.reading_order: Top-down: application through the device mapper into the ZRAID driver's functional and state components, then down to the physical ZNS devices and their zone layout.

light-blue fill of the Dev0-Dev2 boxes and the ZRWA/Durable zone segments
gray fill of the in-memory structure boxes (Stripe Buffer, WP States, ZRWA Block Bitmap) and the Empty zone segment
Semi-durable/PP zone-segment fills and secondary text

style.arrows: orthogonal lines with filled triangular heads, several bidirectional between components and their state

encoding.color_means: white boxes represent core ZRAID functional components; gray boxes represent the in-memory data structures those components use
encoding.line_style_means: dashed horizontal boundaries separate the application, device-mapper, kernel-space driver, and device layers; solid arrows show read/write and I/O flows
encoding.emphasis: separates functional logic (white) from in-memory state (gray) inside the ZRAID driver, and draws the zone layout only once (Dev 0) since Dev 1/Dev 2 repeat it

white-vs-gray box coding distinguishing logic components from state

evidence: The white boxes within the ZRAID driver represent core functional components of ZRAID.
The grey boxes signify the key in-memory structures utilized by those components.
For simplicity, only one of the multiple physical zones in each device is depicted.

summary: ZRAID is a software ZNS RAID layer that uses the Zone Random Write Area (ZRWA) feature to store partial parity near each data zone's write pointer, avoiding the throughput and write-amplification costs of dedicated parity-log zones. This figure shows ZRAID's layered architecture: an application accesses a single logical ZNS device through a device mapper, which routes requests into the kernel-space ZRAID driver. Inside the driver, white boxes (I/O Submitter, Completion Handler, ZRWA Manager) are core functional components, while gray boxes (Stripe Buffer, WP States, ZRWA Block Bitmap) are the in-memory state they read and update, connected by labelled Read/Write, Read, Update and Read/Reset arrows. At the bottom, the driver submits sub-I/Os and WP-advance commands to, and receives interrupts from, the I/O devices; only Dev 0 shows its internal zone layout (ZRWA, Durable, Semi-durable, PP, Empty regions by ascending block address), since Dev 1 and Dev 2 mirror it.
summary_zh: 该图展示ZRAID的分层架构：应用经设备映射器进入内核态ZRAID驱动，白色框为核心功能组件（I/O提交器、完成处理器、ZRWA管理器），灰色框为其使用的内存状态；底部驱动向物理ZNS设备提交子I/O并接收中断，仅Dev 0展示区域布局。
